entry.title: v1.19.1
entry.content:
What's Changed

  • fix: bump Go 1.26.6 and x/net to resolve CVE-2026-39821 by @Manoj-Kumar-Selvaraj in #17230
  • fix: update Go to address CVE-2026-56853 by @Sashang-debug in #17232
  • Fix missing autogen webhook expansion for NamespacedValidatingPolicy (Cherry-pick #17262) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17273
  • fix: apply HTTP blocklist to apiCall.service executor (cherry-pick #17234) by @realshuting in #17298
  • fix: harden apiCall.service egress proxy path and cover CABundle branch (Cherry-pick #17299) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17302
  • fix: avoid data race in image evaluator prefetch (Cherry-pick #17313) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17327
  • cherry-pick: fix IVPol PolicyException scope bypass (GHSA-5cjf-wwfg-pj4c) by @realshuting in #17307
  • fix: close IPv6-embedded-IPv4 blocklist bypass in apiCall.service egress (Cherry-pick #17310) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17329
  • fix(test): disable mutateDigest in exceptions-disabled IVPol by @IceCodeBear in #17336
  • fix(test): loosen chainsaw stderr checks to contains by @IceCodeBear in #17334
  • Bump kyverno sdk to 68d74afcb07a by @raunak-nirmata in #17349
  • fix(test): disable IVPol digest defaults in leftover fixtures in v1.19 by @IceCodeBear in #17356
  • fix(deps): bump golang.org/x/mod to v0.40.0 by @IceCodeBear in #17358
  • fix: backport 7ac176a apiCall urlPath hardening to release-1.19 by @realshuting in #17361
  • feat: phase1 deprecation warning plumbing and CLI warning enforcement (Cherry-pick #17362) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17378
  • fix: validate PolicyException CEL match conditions (Cherry-pick #17350) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17373
  • fix(test): disable IVPol digest defaults in leftover report fixtures by @IceCodeBear in #17376
  • fix(background-controller): watch background-scan reports for the ephemeral reports circuit breaker (Cherry-pick #17136) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17430
  • fix: handle missing reports CRDs as no-op in kyverno-init (Cherry-pick #17420) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17435
  • feat: add deprecation warnings to legacy CRD versions and migrate test fixtures off v2beta1 (Cherry-pick #17428) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17434
  • fix: skip namespace lookup in exception matching when no namespaceSelector is defined (Cherry-pick #17140) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17437
  • fix(gpol): propagate synchronize option to UpdateRequests (Cherry-pick #16920) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17446
  • fix(globalcontext): fix deadlocks in entry lifecycle and watch error handling (Cherry-pick #16904) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17454
  • fix(webhook): avoid redundant recorder notifications (Cherry-pick #17059) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17451
  • [release-1.19] fix: deny globalContext in namespaced policies (#17377) by @realshuting in #17455
  • [release-1.19] fix(cel): read PolicyExceptions from the manager cache, not a second informer (#16993) by @realshuting in #17464
  • fix(reports): fix label prefix and metadata for namespaced CEL policies (Cherry-pick #17460) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17480
  • fix: close layer readers per-iteration to avoid FD/memory leak (Cherry-pick #16994) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17498
  • [release-1.19] fix(deps): upgrade golang.org/x/crypto to v0.56.0 and grpc to v1.83.2 by @realshuting in #17513
  • fix(gpol): recreate downstream resource after repeated deletions (Cherry-pick #17453) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17520
  • fix: skip scalar values during wildcard image extraction (Cherry-pick #16268) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17521
  • chore: cut release v1.19.1-rc.1 by @realshuting in #17522
  • feat(cel): extend autogen to custom workload CRDs (JobSet, etc.) via structural extraction (Cherry-pick #17014) by @Rohanraj123 in #17530
  • fix(reports): discover autogen'd IVPol/NIVPol targets for background scan (Cherry-pick #17395) by @kyverno-pr-updater[bot] in #17447
  • chore: cut release v1.19.1 by @realshuting in #17541

New Contributors

  • @Manoj-Kumar-Selvaraj made their first contribution in #17230

Full Changelog: v1.19.0...v1.19.1
